name: Installs Package
description: This host has this package installed: the package manager's database on the host lists it (an apk in /lib/apk/db, a dpkg or rpm entry, a pip or npm install). A reference, not containment: a package is shared by every host that installs it and outlives any one of them. Drawn from the SBOM of the environment the host represents; the SBOM's document is recorded on the package (source_document), not on the edge.
